text:
Elaine (PM): quick heads-up — i'm proposing a 'scope accordion' + timeline reset for the mvp -> v1 plan. want to align today before i push to stakeholders
Sam (Eng): can you sketch what "scope accordion" means here? expand/contract by priority?
Elaine (PM): yeah — prioritize the absolute runtime surface (text gen + streaming + embeddings) into MVP. everything else (console polish, advanced routing, billing UX) slides to v1 if we need to compress
Maria (Design): 👍 my ask: keep critical observability bits in MVP so support can onboard customers. visual polish can wait
Ravi (SRE): from infra side, the main risk is canary + autoscale tuning. if console telemetry is out, we still need request-level traces in MVP
Jen (QA): test surface: we can shrink end-to-end UI tests and focus on API regression + quality tests. will need a small prompt-suite for perf/quality gating
Diego (ProdOps): also flagging customer pilots: Acme and BetaCo expect console features. recommend we expose a dedicated early-access flag rather than ship full console
Sam (Eng): rough timeline suggestion:
```
Sprint A (2w): API core + streaming + basic auth
Sprint B (2w): KV cache + canary infra + tracing
Sprint C (2w): telemetry + console alpha (opt-in)
```
Elaine (PM): if we accept that, MVP freeze = end of Sprint B, then v1 ship window after Sprint C. tradeoff: moves console GA but keeps runtime stability for customers
Maria (Design): that feels reasonable. we'll deliver console alpha flows behind feature-flag for Acme pilot
Ravi (SRE): must add fallback path: if canary shows >20% request errors, auto-fallback to smaller model variant. i'll add runbook
Jen (QA): i'll prepare regression tests and a 30-case prompt smoke suite. ETA EOD Wed
Sam (Eng): i'll drop a PR with the reduced scope checklist and mark items for v1. ping me if you need re-prioritization
Elaine (PM): action items: (1) Sam PR with scope checklist (2) Ravi runbook & canary thresholds (3) Jen prompt-suite (4) Maria console alpha flows for flag. i'll update stakeholders after sync. any objections?
Diego (ProdOps): no objections, +1 for feature-flag approach. can we also add a short customer note template?
Elaine (PM): good call — i'll draft a short pilot note and share in #customer-communications. aiming to send after we have the PR merged
deploy-bot: reminder — scheduled weekly planning sync in 3h — thread pinned
Elaine (PM): thanks all. if no blockers, i'll do the timeline reset and label the Jira epics accordingly :thumbsup:
